title: Assistance technique pour la phase pilote du Projet de Digitalisation des Mairies au Togo
publisher: Ministère de l'Efficacité du Service Public et de la Transformation Numérique
why_not: A KfW tender notice (deadline 10 August 2026) describing PDiMa as digitalisation of civil registration with a pilot in sixteen communes; it names no connection of the mairies, so it states no plan for the connection, and owner and donor finance are already held.
